Contre un mur, descends la tête vers le: Against a wall, lower your head toward the floor with control.

Mains sur le banc derrière toi, fesses p: Hands on the bench behind you, hips close to the bench.
Buste penché, bras collé au corps, tends: Bent over, upper arm tight to your body, extend your forearm backward.
Avant-bras posés sur les cuisses, seuls: Forearms resting on your thighs, only your wrists move.
Reste suspendu bras tendus, épaules légè: Hang with arms straight, shoulders slightly engaged.

Barre au-dessus du milieu du pied, tibia: Bar over the middle of your foot, shins close to the bar at the start.
Pieds très écartés, mains entre les jamb: Feet very wide, hands between your legs.
La jambe libre part vers l'arrière, bass: The free leg goes back, hips facing the floor.
Chevilles bloquées, descends le buste ve: Ankles locked, lower your torso forward as slowly as possible.
La force vient des hanches : les bras ne: The power comes from the hips: your arms just hold the kettlebell.

Assis, écarte les jambes contre la résis: Seated, push your legs apart against the resistance, return slowly.
Assis, resserre les jambes contre la rés: Seated, squeeze your legs together against the resistance, return slowly.
À quatre pattes, lève le genou plié sur: On all fours, lift your bent knee out to the side without rotating your hips.
Coude vers le genou opposé, en alternant: Elbow to the opposite knee, alternating.
À genoux, enroule le buste vers le sol,: Kneeling, curl your torso toward the floor, hips fixed.
Sur un avant-bras, corps de profil et al: On one forearm, body sideways and aligned, hips high.
Dos plaqué, tends un bras et la jambe op: Back flat, extend one arm and the opposite leg, alternating.
Bras et jambes tendus au-dessus du sol,: Arms and legs extended above the floor, lower back pressed down; hold.
De profil à la poulie, pousse les mains: Standing sideways to the cable, press your hands out in front of you without letting your torso rotate.
Roule vers l'avant sans creuser le dos,: Roll forward without arching your back, return by contracting your abs.
Banc à 45°, descends le buste puis remon: Bench at 45°, lower your torso then come back up to a straight line, without arching.
À quatre pattes, tends un bras et la jam: On all fours, extend one arm and the opposite leg, back flat.
Enchaîne un squat avant et un développé: Combine a front squat and an overhead press in one movement.
Explosion des hanches, la barre monte pr: Explode through the hips, the bar travels up close to your body to your shoulders. Learn it with a coach.
Du sol à debout, bras tendu vers le plaf: From the floor to standing, arm extended toward the ceiling with the weight, step by step.
Squat avec un médecine-ball, puis lance-: Squat with a medicine ball, then throw it against the wall as you stand up.
Genoux fléchis, fais onduler les cordes: Knees bent, make waves with the ropes by alternating arms.
À quatre pattes, genoux juste au-dessus: On all fours, knees just above the floor, move your opposite hand and foot forward.
Saute sur la boîte à deux pieds, descend: Jump onto the box with both feet, step down.
Prise large, passe le bâton de l'avant v: Wide grip, pass the stick from front to back with arms straight.
À quatre pattes, arrondis puis creuse do: On all fours, gently round then arch your back with your breathing.
En fente, main au sol, ouvre l'autre bra: In a lunge, hand on the floor, open the other arm toward the ceiling.
Face au mur, avance le genou vers le mur: Facing a wall, drive your knee toward the wall without lifting your heel.
Descends le plus bas confortable, talons: Go as low as is comfortable, heels down; breathe and hold.
Debout, attrape la cheville derrière toi: Standing, grab your ankle behind you, knees side by side.
En fente, genou arrière au sol, avance d: In a lunge, back knee on the floor, gently push your hips forward.
Mains au mur, jambe arrière tendue, talo: Hands on the wall, back leg straight, heel down.
Avant-bras contre un encadrement de port: Forearm against a door frame, gently lean your torso forward.
Main derrière la tête, pousse doucement: Hand behind your head, gently push your elbow with the other hand.
Ramène le bras tendu contre la poitrine: Pull your straight arm across your chest with the other arm.
À genoux, fesses vers les talons, bras a: Kneeling, hips toward your heels, arms stretched out in front.
Jambe avant pliée devant toi, jambe arri: Front leg bent in front of you, back leg extended, torso slowly lowering.
Allongé sur le ventre, pousse doucement: Lying on your stomach, gently press up on your hands, hips on the floor.
Assis sur la machine, dos plaqué contre: Sit on the machine, back flat against the pad, handles at shoulder height, arms open to the sides, elbows slightly bent.
Ouvre lentement jusqu'à sentir l'étireme: Open slowly until you feel the stretch, without going past shoulder line.
Rapproche les poignées devant la poitrin: Bring the handles together in front of your chest in an arc.
Serre les pectoraux une seconde, mains j: Squeeze your chest for a second, hands together.
Des bras ouverts à la ligne des épaules: From arms open at shoulder level to hands together in front of your chest.
Exhale as you close, inhale as you open.
Garde la même flexion des coudes du débu: Keep the same elbow bend from start to finish.
Règle le siège pour avoir les poignées à: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Lifting your back off the pad.
Letting the weights slam as you open.
Pousser avec les bras en pliant les coud: Pushing with your arms by bending your elbows.
Debout entre les deux poulies hautes, un: Standing between the two high pulleys, a handle in each hand, one foot forward, torso slightly leaning, arms open, elbows slightly bent.
Amène les mains l'une vers l'autre devan: Bring your hands toward each other in front of your lower chest in an arc.
Des bras ouverts dans la ligne des épaul: From arms open at shoulder level to hands together.
Coudes fixes, le mouvement vient des épa: Elbows fixed, the movement comes from the shoulders.
Se laisser tirer vers l'arrière par les: Letting the cables pull you backward.
Turning the fly into a press.
Debout, barre posée sur l'avant des épau: Standing, bar resting on the front of your shoulders against your collarbones, arms crossed in front (or clean grip), elbows high, feet shoulder-width apart.
Descends en gardant le buste bien droit: Lower while keeping your torso upright and your elbows high.
Genoux dans l'axe des pieds jusqu'aux cu: Knees in line with your feet, down to parallel thighs.
Au moins jusqu'aux cuisses parallèles, b: At least to parallel thighs, torso upright.
Coudes hauts pour que la barre ne glisse: Elbows high so the bar doesn't slip.
